purpose: Teach: 誓い/あれだけ/家内/伯父/和室/帰れる/仕立て/籠

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お店、続けるって、本気で、絶対、誓い、絶対、立ててるの
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious — I'm going to keep this shop running. I promise you that.
lines.style: Warm, steady conviction. Speaks slowly, letting each phrase land. Eye contact held. The weight of a real promise, not just a wish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、あれだけ、絶対、頑張ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I tried really hard. I did everything you asked.
lines.style: Small but genuine pride in his voice. Speaks plainly, without embellishment. Looks up at her, checking that she sees he meant it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お、本気で、絶対、家内、絶対、安全、絶対、お祈りしてるわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm praying every day that our family stays safe and well.
lines.style: Soft, almost meditative tone. Gentle certainty. She's not asking for agreement — just speaking something true. Slight catch on 'family.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、伯父、絶対、さん、絶対、いる?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, is Uncle... is Uncle still coming?
lines.style: Uncertain, seeking reassurance. Asks the first part quickly, then pauses before the second — he's worrying about something. Small, watchful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、和室、絶対、お祖父ちゃんと、絶対、片付けてね
lines.en: Sho, after you finish tidying the tatami room with Grandpa, you can rest, okay?
lines.style: Gentle direction, not a demand. Warm but practical. The tone of someone delegating something she trusts him to do well.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、もう、本気で、絶対、帰れる、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can go home now, right? I'm ready.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, confident. He's stated a fact more than asked a question. Small and sure of himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、仕立て、絶対、のいい、絶対、お洋服、絶対、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho, those clothes your father wore — they're so well-made and elegant, aren't they?
lines.style: Admiring, nostalgic undertone. Speaks warmly about someone absent. The affection in her voice is clear but not heavy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お庭で、本気で、絶対、籠、絶対、にお花、絶対、いっぱい入れたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I filled up the garden basket with so many flowers for you.
lines.style: Bright pride, eager to share. Opens up at the end — he wants her to know he did something for her. Genuine small-kid happiness.
